name: Silas
bio: Silas, a leading man among the Jerusalem brethren and a prophet, was chosen along with Judas Barsabas to carry the Jerusalem Council's letter to the Gentile believers in Antioch, encouraging them that they need not be circumcised but should abstain from food offered to idols, blood, meat from strangled animals, and sexual immorality; afterward he chose to remain in Antioch. When Paul and Barnabas later split over whether to bring John Mark on their next journey, Paul chose Silas as his companion instead, and the two departed for Syria and Cilicia (Acts 15:22-41). His further travels with Paul are told in the chapters ahead.
